---

> **How to Use This Template**
>
> Replace all placeholder text in `[brackets]` with your research findings. Each persona section captures the essential information product teams, designers, and engineers need to build with empathy.
>
> **Best practices:** Base personas on real user research (interviews, surveys, analytics) rather than assumptions. Aim for 3–5 personas per product. Review and update quarterly or when new research is available. Share widely with your team.
>
> **Tip:** Duplicate a persona section to add more. Delete any sections you don't need.
